---
title: "Swiss administrative geometries"
description: "Choose an official boundary product for analysis or mapping."
---

<div class="toolbox-kind">Resource</div>

| Product | Prefer it for |
|---|---|
| OFS historized administrative boundaries G1 | Normal spatial analysis; default choice |
| OFS K4 | Lightweight visualization when its generalization is sufficient |
| swissBOUNDARIES3D | Work that genuinely needs much higher geometric precision |

For G1 and K4, prefer discovery through stable geo.admin STAC collection IDs over maintaining annual download URLs. Known IDs awaiting verification are:

```text
ch.bfs.historisierte-administrative_grenzen_g1
ch.bfs.historisierte-administrative_grenzen_k4
```

Prefer GPKG or GeoJSON assets. Use Shapefile only when a downstream system requires it.
